channel.title: RideMeme Digest — Philippine & world motoring
channel.description: The day's top Philippine and world motoring stories, auto-curated.

item.title: Tesla PH Updates Model 3 Anew At No Extra Cost
item.description: The Roadster 2 may be Tesla’s future , but for the here and now, the carmaker has announced updates to its Model 3 which come at no extra cost for orders placed today. Read More »

item.title: Tesla boosts Model Y L, expands Phl network
item.description: Tesla has improved the acceleration of its six-seater Model Y L electric SUV while expanding its charging network and customer facilities in the Philippines.

item.title: Honda updates Click160 for 2027
item.description: Honda Philippines has introduced the 2027 Click160 with a revised 157cc engine, sportier styling and additional features for everyday use. The updated scooter carries a suggested retail price of P110,000.

item.title: Lights, Camara, action!
item.description: Sao Paulo, Brazil (AFP) — Brazilian Rafael Camara will race for Haas in 2027, the Formula 1 team announced on Thursday, after confirming the departure of French driver Esteban Ocon last month.

item.title: VinFast offers dealers up to $60K
item.description: VinFast is offering incentives of up to US$60,000 per new electric motorcycle dealership in the Philippines and Indonesia as the Vietnamese automaker seeks to expand its sales network in both countries before the end of the year.

item.title: JOYEE readies three models
item.description: Chinese automaker FAWCAR is preparing to introduce three JOYEE new-energy vehicles in the Philippines on 22 October, with the S04 electric SUV, S08 hybrid SUV and N09 flagship coupe scheduled for unveiling in Manila.

item.title: Geely, NIO seal power pact
item.description: Geely Holding Group and NIO have agreed to invest in each other’s energy businesses as the two Chinese automakers work toward a shared network of electric vehicle charging and battery-swapping stations.

item.title: Suzuki upgrades Manila Bay dealership
item.description: Suzuki Philippines has relaunched its Manila Bay dealership in Pasay City with improved showroom and service facilities through its longtime dealer partner, Wheels Inc.

item.title: Green SM goes stateside
item.description: Green SM, the Vietnamese electric taxi operator already operating in the Philippines, has expanded to the United States with the launch of its all-electric taxi service in Los Angeles, California, on 13 October.

item.title: Tyler Reddick Wins at Phoenix to Keep NASCAR Championship Chances Alive; Larson DNFs
item.description: Tyler Reddick races his way back into the championship picture with his sixth win of 2026 and first since April.

item.title: This Has Got To Be The Most Perfect Way To Get Around Rome
item.description: All of our lives would be better if we had Fiat 500 Jollys to drive around.

item.title: Pros And Cons Of EV Vs. Internal Combustion Off-Road SUVs
item.description: EVs are expensive, but they bring instant torque and fewer parts to break. Here's where they beat ICE off-roaders on the trail, and where they fall short.
